high.description: You're highly results-oriented and driven. You love challenges, take charge naturally, and prefer direct communication. You thrive in fast-paced environments where you can make decisions and see immediate results.
challenges: May be impatient with slower processes
Can be seen as too direct or blunt
May overlook details in pursuit of goals
high.communicationStyle: Direct, brief, and focused on outcomes. Prefers getting to the point quickly.

moderate.description: You balance assertiveness with collaboration. You can take charge when needed but also work well with others. You're comfortable with both challenges and routine.
challenges: May struggle to assert in highly competitive settings
moderate.communicationStyle: Balanced - direct when needed, diplomatic when appropriate.

low.description: You prefer collaboration over competition and are thoughtful about decisions. You're comfortable supporting others and value careful planning over quick action.
low.communicationStyle: Thoughtful and diplomatic. Takes time to consider responses.

influence.name: Influence (I)
influence.shortDescription: Sociable, persuasive, and thrives on collaboration

high.description: You're naturally outgoing, enthusiastic, and persuasive. You love working with people, building relationships, and creating positive energy. You thrive in social, collaborative environments where you can inspire and motivate others.
challenges: May avoid conflict to maintain harmony
Needs social interaction to stay motivated
high.communicationStyle: Warm, enthusiastic, and expressive. Focuses on building rapport.

moderate.description: You balance social interaction with independent work. You enjoy collaboration but also appreciate time alone. You're comfortable building relationships without needing constant social engagement.
challenges: May struggle in extremely social or isolated roles
workPreferences: Mix of teamwork and solo work
moderate.communicationStyle: Friendly and approachable, but can also be reserved when needed.

low.description: You prefer working independently or in small groups. You're more reserved in social settings and communicate in a more serious, factual manner. You focus on tasks rather than socializing.
challenges: Less comfortable in large group settings
low.communicationStyle: Reserved and factual. Prefers written communication or one-on-one.

high.description: You're patient, reliable, and value stability. You prefer consistent routines, clear expectations, and harmonious environments. You're a supportive team member who builds trust through dependability.
challenges: Can be slow to adapt to new situations
May avoid conflict at all costs
high.communicationStyle: Calm, patient, and supportive. Takes time to build trust.

moderate.description: You balance stability with flexibility. You appreciate routine but can adapt to change when needed. You're supportive without being overly accommodating.
challenges: May struggle with extreme instability or rapid change
moderate.communicationStyle: Balanced - supportive but can also be direct when needed.

low.description: You embrace change and variety. You're comfortable with fast-paced environments, quick decisions, and shifting priorities. You prefer action over routine.
challenges: Can be restless in stable environments
low.communicationStyle: Energetic and direct. Comfortable with quick exchanges.

high.description: You're analytical, detail-oriented, and value accuracy and quality. You prefer structured environments with clear standards. You think systematically and focus on getting things right.
high.communicationStyle: Precise, detailed, and formal. Focuses on facts and data.

moderate.description: You balance attention to detail with big-picture thinking. You value quality but can also be flexible when needed. You're organized without being rigid.
challenges: May struggle with extreme chaos or rigid structure
moderate.communicationStyle: Balanced - can be detailed or high-level as needed.

low.description: You prefer the big picture over details. You're comfortable with ambiguity and quick decisions. You focus on innovation and moving forward rather than perfecting processes.
low.communicationStyle: Informal and conceptual. Focuses on big ideas over details.
